findings.text: follow-on: the log's first line records revision 9a30e4e88a26e96e606f196bcf7a799043b5308e as the revision it ran at, but its result is 7 tests (1 failed, 6 passed) including test_isolation_guard_watches_the_legacy_store_home which does not exist at that revision, so the log was run on the working tree carrying the uncommitted test change; naming only the base revision reads as a base-revision result of six tests, whereas the sibling head-friction-only.log:1 discloses "+ uncommitted test change".

follow-on: the baseline_suite and after_suite command fields name the gate as "... <26 gate files>" rather than the literal command that ran, which the manifest contract forbids; the gate log's own header line 3 does carry the literal 26 absolute paths, so the command is recoverable, but a reader of the manifest alone cannot reconstruct or re-run it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; the old comparison-only test test_isolation_guard_watches_the_escape_destination is replaced by a helper _isolated_guard_home and two layout cases, and an evidence fragment is added; no product code changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names three mutant conditions; the manifest records the mutant results, and I reproduced all three independently at head e12c1e50f (see tests below).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make tests/test_member_friction.py compare the member-friction guard's resolved store against an independent expectation rather than against real_store_home(), the helper the guard itself calls; tests/test_member_friction.py:171-224 now builds a temporary HOME with RECKON_HOME pointed elsewhere and asserts _guard_store() equals <HOME>/.config/reckon (XDG case) and <HOME>/docs-server (legacy case), both computed from HOME alone.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries the base/head revision pair, baseline_suite and after_suite JSON (both completed:true, exit 0, zero failures), a negative_control_log with a note, and the changed_paths; its head revision e12c1e50f equals the worktree head and the worktree was clean, so the head gate's tree is the committed tree; its baseline_suite and after_suite command fields carry an angle-bracket placeholder instead of the literal command (FINDING below).
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff 9a30e4e88..e12c1e50f lists exactly tests/test_member_friction.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/member-friction-guard-fails-on-a-wrong-store.html, both inside the node's declared write paths; tests/conftest.py is declared optional and was not touched.

justifications.durability: reinstating the guard regression (tests/test_member_friction.py:73, _guard_store returning the XDG literal fallback) reddens test_isolation_guard_watches_the_legacy_store_home, and making real_store_home keep RECKON_HOME reddens both test_isolation_guard_watches_the_xdg_store_home and test_isolation_guard_watches_the_legacy_store_home, both reproduced.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran tests/test_member_friction.py at head e12c1e50f (7 passed) and reproduced both declared mutants (XDG-literal fallback: 1 failed/6 passed on the legacy case; keep-RECKON_HOME: 2 failed/5 passed), but the recorded negative-control-xdg-literal.log header names only the base revision while its tree held the new tests, unlike the sibling head-friction-only.log which discloses the uncommitted test change.
justifications.fit: _isolated_guard_home at tests/test_member_friction.py:171 follows the file's existing monkeypatch/tmp_path idiom and carries no plan, section or version label in its name, docstring or in the two new test names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_member_friction.py:219 and :231 assert the guard's target against home / ".config" / "reckon" and home / "docs-server", values derived from the test's own HOME and independent of real_store_home().
justifications.reuse: I searched tests/ by capability for a temp-HOME-with-optional-.config/reckon fixture (the autouse isolated_reckon_home at tests/conftest.py:1119 isolates RECKON_HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME, a different capability) and found no owner, so the test-local helper forks nothing.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 9a30e4e88..e12c1e50f touches only tests/test_member_friction.py and the evidence fragment named in the manifest's changed_paths, both inside the declared write paths.
